messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (P1) — GPU pool us-west-1a queue depth > 3k, autoscaler attempted scalex3 but provisioning errors observed from cloud provider. Affecting inference latency and 502s. Root thread created.

alice_prod_oncall: I'm on it. calling for on-call bridge. tagging infra/sre. can someone grab diagnostics?

ben_infra: pulling metrics now. queue growth started ~22:12 UTC. autoscaler sent 4 scale requests at 22:13-22:14, provider returned 429/QuotaExceeded on each. autoscaler logs show repeated error: `provisioning_error: provider_quota_exceeded`.

carla_sre: echo — also seeing KV cache pressure and continuous batching backlog. slow tokens per request spiking.

devon_prodeng: do we have a failover policy? can we route low-priority tenants to cpu-fallback models to reduce GPU demand?

alice_prod_oncall: yes. immediate plan: 1) enable route-level fallback to cpu-fallback for non-real-time tiers 2) apply per-tenant concurrency caps for heavy tenants 3) pause non-prod batch jobs queued to GPUs. who can run the routing flip?

ben_infra: I can run it. preparing the rollout command. will flip a traffic split to `cpu-fallback` for route tag `tier:best_effort`.

ben_infra: executing:```sh
# route switch
redwoodctl routes update --match 'tier:best_effort' --target cpu-fallback --percent 100
# confirm
redwoodctl routes describe --match 'tier:best_effort'
```

ops-bot: Action recorded: route change requested by ben_infra. ETA: ~45s to propagate.

sam_support: customer impact snapshot: 7 customers reported increased latency/502s. top affected: AcmeCRM (15% traffic), NovaSearch (5%), internal prod tests. Estimated affected request volume ~12k rps peak window.

nora_customer_success: I'm drafting an incident note for AcmeCRM and NovaSearch. will say we're mitigating and will follow up with RCA.

carla_sre: additional mitigation: temporarily lower global batch_size cap to 8 and set `max_concurrency_per_tenant=50` for top 10 tenants. this will reduce queue length quickly.

devon_prodeng: agree. also propose we spin up reserved fallback nodes in another region (us-west-2) if provider quotas are regional. need infra approval.

ben_infra: quota response from provider: "rate limit quota for on-demand GPUs exceeded; request the quota increase or use reserved capacity." I've started a support ticket but quota increase is not instant.

alice_prod_oncall: ok. immediate actions executed: route flip done, batch cap lowered, per-tenant caps applied, paused non-prod batch jobs. monitoring impact.

ops-bot: Metric update (22:20 UTC): queue depth down 28%, GPU 95th latency improved from 2.2s -> 1.1s for priority tiers. overall error rate down 60%.

sam_support: customer inbound volume: AcmeCRM reports degraded experience but accepts temporary fallback. NovaSearch on a brief maintenance window. No major revenue-impacting alerts so far.

ben_infra: temporary manual scale: we provisioned 6 reserved GPUs in us-west-2 using reserved instance pool. This required approval from infra lead and is active. should help head off more queue growth while provider quota is sorted.

carla_sre: logs from autoscaler indicate a bug where retry backoff was effectively infinite when provider returned 429 with empty Retry-After header. autoscaler stopped retrying new provisioning attempts for ~18m. snippet:
```text
2026-02-11T22:14:12Z autoscaler: attempt=3 provider_error=429 details="quota_exceeded" retry_after=""
2026-02-11T22:14:12Z autoscaler: backoff_next=inf

# expected: backoff_next should be computed or default to 30s
```

devon_prodeng: that's a clear cause for scale suppression. we'll patch autoscaler to default to 30s backoff if Retry-After missing. adding test for provider 429/no-retry header.

alice_prod_oncall: summarizing mitigation timeline for post-incident notes: 22:12 detection -> 22:14 first scale attempt -> 22:14-22:32 scale suppressed due to backoff bug -> 22:20 route flip & caps -> 22:30 reserved nodes online -> 22:35 error rate stable. please correct if wrong.

ben_infra: timeline ok. add: 22:28 support ticket opened with provider. 22:33 manual pool provision succeeded.

nora_customer_success: I'll send an initial status update to impacted customers now. will include ETA for RCA and mention fallback routing.

sam_support: created a customer-impact doc and pinned it to the channel. link: <https://redwood.internal/docs/incidents/5861239876-impact> (internal).

carla_sre: immediate triage conclusions: primary root cause = autoscaler backoff bug + exhausted on-demand provider quota. secondary contributing factors = high non-priority batch traffic and no pre-authorized reserved buffer for peak events.

devon_prodeng: proposed postmortem action items (brief): - patch autoscaler to handle missing Retry-After (owner: devon_prodeng, due: 2026-02-18) - increase reserved capacity buffer for us-west region to 10 GPUs (owner: ben_infra, due: 2026-02-15) - implement tenant-level surge protection by default (owner: carla_sre, due: 2026-02-22) - update runbook to include provider quota checks and manual reserve playbook (owner: alice_prod_oncall, due: 2026-02-16)

alice_prod_oncall: I'll run the post-incident bridge and kick off a formal RCA doc. any objections?

nora_customer_success: no objections. I'll coordinate customer comms for the RCA release.

ops-bot: Incident status changed to "mitigated" at 22:41 UTC. Postmortem required.

sam_support: logging final notes and action items into tracking board. will assign owners and follow up.

carla_sre: small follow-up: add an automated alert when autoscaler backoff exceeds 2 minutes cumulatively. that'll catch similar suppression cases earlier. owner: carla_sre.

ben_infra: created infra ticket for reserved buffer and provider quota precheck automation. ticket ID IR-2026-447.

alice_prod_oncall: thanks team. great execution. we'll review in tomorrow's incident retro and ship fixes as prioritized. closing thread for live coordination.

nora_customer_success: sending final customer note now with mitigation summary and promise of RCA within 48h. :white_check_mark:
